pr_title: fix: Service Workers+Interception: missing page-level Network events
pr_body:
Fixes #15474.

Notes:

* page-level requests that are also handled by a SW's fetch handler, should not be interceptable at the page-level
* `Network.requestWillBeSent` does not provide enough metadata for Playwright to fire the `request` event at that time, so it does it as soon as it gets to the end of the request lifecycle

issue_context.title: [BUG] Page Request Served from SW Cache: Missing Page-Request Event
issue_context.body:
See https://gist.github.com/rwoll/100f361aca78838aad3d138eac30f35a#file-example-spec-ts-L90.

If a page makes a request, even if the SW fetch handler responds from https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Cache, we should still see the request on the page itself.
comments: Moving back to 1.24. Proposed fix/PR linked. Turns out it wasn't just cache and was a major gap in the feature!
